episodes.title: Overcoming Cult Abuse with Guest Margaret Bronson
episodes.description: Overcoming Cult Abuse with Guest Margaret Bronson, Founder of Deconstruction Doulas together with Host Tina Huggins, Divorce & “Narcissist Conflict” Specialist | The Awakening Breaking free from a controlling environment is only the beginning—healing, rebuilding trust, and rediscovering your identity can be a journey of its own. Join Tina Huggins on The Awakening as she welcomes Margaret Bronson, Founder of Deconstruction Doulas, for an important conversation about overcoming cult abuse and reclaiming your life. Margaret and Tina explore the dynamics of control, manipulation, fear, isolation, and emotional abuse, along with the challenges survivors may face as they question deeply held beliefs and begin rebuilding their sense of self. Discover the importance of recognizing unhealthy patterns, establishing boundaries, finding supportive connections, and moving toward greater personal freedom. This powerful conversation offers awareness, understanding, and hope for those healing from coercive or high-control relationships and environments. More about Tina: Tina Huggins, CTA Life Coach certified, CDC Divorce Coach, CDC Transitions Coach, CDC Recovery Coach, TKG Restorative Family Mediator Certified, TKG Family Circle Certified. I have coached for over 30 years coming from the background of law enforcement and self-defense instructor. Connect with Tina: Email: coachtinalynn@gmail.com Website: https://divorcecoachspecialist More about Margaret: Margaret Bronson is the founder of Deconstruction Doulas, which serves those affected by religious trauma, spiritual abuse, and high-control religion. Margaret was born and raised in southeastern Pennsylvania, where her family became part of an evangelical, Christian Reconstructionist cult, until she escaped at 20 years old with the help of her now-husband. Margaret is a writer, activist, and mother to four children. She currently serves as Deconstruction Doulas' program director.
